# Handbill: Invoices & Estimates

> Handbill is an iPhone app (iOS 17+) for solo tradespeople and small service businesses to write estimates, turn them into invoices, send PDF invoices by email or text, and track who has paid. Made by BoomBoom LLC.

## Key facts
- Who it's for: electricians, plumbers, HVAC, handymen, house cleaners, lawn care, landscapers, painters, pressure washing, roofers, carpenters, flooring, pool service, appliance repair, pest control, window cleaning, junk removal, mobile mechanics, general contractors.
- Pick your trade on first launch; Handbill fills in common jobs, units and wording. You set your own prices.
- "Describe the job": type what you did in plain words and get priced invoice lines.
- One tap turns an accepted estimate into an invoice.
- Overdue invoices are flagged.
- No account, no server, works offline. Data stays on the iPhone.
- Never processes payments and takes no fees. Clients pay you directly; you mark invoices paid.
- Back up to a file and restore it on a new phone (free). Includes clients, documents, photos, payments, saved prices, trades, logo, invoice style and settings.
- Eight invoice styles, three of them laid out for kinds of trades: Statement (amount due large at the top, for cleaning and lawn care), Work order (boxed fields, gridded table, signature line, for plumbing, HVAC, electrical, auto repair) and Contractor (side stripe and info cards, for roofing and remodeling).
- iPhone only: no Android or web version.

## Pricing
- Free: unlimited estimates and clients, 3 invoices.
- Pro: $7.99/month or $49.99/year (save 48%, $4.17/month; yearly starts with a free week). Unlimited invoices, logo on PDFs, seven extra invoice styles (Modern, Bold, Statement, Work order, Contractor, Ledger, Elegant) in ten colors, logo size, shape (circle or rounded), placement and white-background removal, no Handbill footer, overdue reminders.
